summary: The registered fructose-versus-chow result agrees in direction for 19 of 20 genes in the original paper’s Figure 5b. Crhr1 has the opposite sign, and only Mc3r passes registered BH FDR < 0.05 among the 10 genes the authors marked significant. All 15 individually identified genes in the follow-up complement figure agree in direction. The proposal passed validation, and no ledger was edited.
openIssues: The two papers used different selection rules on the same RNA-seq cohort. Each panel falls below the 30-pair concordance minimum. Two composite complement labels could not be assigned to individual genes.

The full Cuffdiff table was not located. Exact author effects, gene-wise P and FDR values, and genome-wide discovery overlap remain unassessed. The figures provide signs or color bands, so no numerical comparison spec was proposed.
